about: Brightness of the city-lights night map at a date, as a fraction of the map (NASA Black Marble, about 2012). World electricity generation stands in for outdoor lighting: a rough proxy (approximate; only the rendered brightness uses it, no value is shown in the UI). Before the first public electric lighting systems there are no lights; the map's geography stays modern (historical cities are a later phase).

rows.source: First public electric lighting: Brush arc-lamp street lighting (1879-1880), Edison's Pearl Street station (1882)
World electricity generation ~10 TWh (Smil 2017, Energy and Civilization), proxy
World electricity generation ~950 TWh (Smil 2017; UN energy statistics), proxy
World electricity generation ~22,700 TWh (IEA); epoch of the NASA Black Marble map
